name: visuals
description: Turn any content into a visual deliverable: self-contained HTML decks, dashboards, infographics and posters; vertical scroll-snap decks built from a Markdown file; and Excalidraw architecture and concept diagrams.

interface.shortDescription: HTML decks, scroll decks, and Excalidraw diagrams from any content
interface.longDescription: Visuals bundles the three skills that turn content into something you can show: visualize writes a single self-contained HTML file — deck, dashboard, infographic, poster, timeline — from a skeleton and a design system; md-to-scrolldeck compresses a Markdown report into a vertical scroll-snap deck for leadership review; excalidraw-diagram generates .excalidraw JSON that argues visually, then renders it to PNG and audits its own output before delivering.
defaultPrompt: Visualize this as an HTML dashboard.
Turn docs/report.md into a scroll deck.
